annotationEncoding: row-major uint8; width * height bytes; no header
boundaryDefinition: class-specific inner pixel with any of eight positions not in that class; outside the image is background
boundaryMatch: distance <= tolerance; independent any-match for each predicted and ground-truth boundary pixel; no one-to-one consumption
boundaryPrecision: matched predicted boundary pixels / predicted boundary pixels
boundaryRecall: matched ground-truth boundary pixels / ground-truth boundary pixels
boundaryF1: 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall); zero if only one side is empty or no matches
iou: same-class intersection pixels / same-class union pixels
absentLayer: jointly absent layer/image pairs have null IoU and boundary F1 and are excluded from means; one-sided absence scores zero
protectedLeakage: count(protection == 255 and effectiveCoverage >= 1) / count(protection == 255); null when denominator is zero
perImageMacro: unweighted mean over non-null layer scores
macroBoundaryAndIou: unweighted mean over eligible layer/image pairs; per-layer means over eligible images; null if none eligible
macroProtectedLeakage: unweighted mean of per-image leakage with nonzero protected denominators; never pooled pixel ratio
benchmarkProtection: each adjudicated image must have at least one protected pixel
baselineSuitability: every image must have protected ground truth; zero aggregate baseline leakage fails before candidate tuning because a 10% relative improvement cannot be proved
laterLabPercentileScope: later LAB statistics only; not boundary matching or quality aggregation
blindAnnotation: two independent humans see working image and these instructions only; no model output; preserve detached A/B byte maps and submission hashes/times; independent adjudicator records every disputed pixel decision before candidate tuning
